slate_notes: Pregame snapshot, first tips 7:00 ET (slate not started). 9 NBA + 2 NHL. Carried the morning panel's four best non-Wagner keeps (Coward, Towns, Stone, Mitchell) and added Nembhard, Spencer, Toppin, Wembanyama, Acuff, plus Wagner TO downgraded for Suggs' likely return. Dropped morning legs the panel cut. Lines are sportsbook proxies; PrizePicks/Underdog direct feeds weren't reachable, so confirm app lines (FGM/TO may not be on both apps). Same-game clusters: NY @ IND (Towns, Nembhard, Toppin) and MEM @ NO (Coward, Spencer); avoid stacking. Break-even: PrizePicks 2-pick 57.7%/leg, 5-pick 54.9%; Underdog 2-pick 53.5%.

legs.reasoning: Coward has 7+ rebounds in 9 of last 10 (7, 11, 11, 7, 7, 9, 9, 9, 6, 11). Memphis is without Zach Edey and Quinten Post, which opens up board share, and New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (doubtful). MEM @ NO has a 236.5 total with both teams top-half pace, so more missed shots to clean up. Book price -112. Pregame update: No change; 3:45 PM report still has Edey/Post out for MEM and Murphy III, Mathurin, Missi doubtful for NO. Morning panel kept 3-0.
legs.injury_notes: MEM: Edey, Post out; NO: Murphy III, Mathurin, Missi doubtful.

legs.reasoning: Towns is averaging 41.0 points+rebounds over his last three (double-double in each, 23.3 FGA+FTA), has a double-double in 10 straight, and averages 35.0 P+R on the road. Indiana allows 52.2% shooting to centers and is bottom-10 in points and rebounds allowed to fives, and is without Haliburton. Risk: NY -8.5 could mean a light fourth quarter. Pregame update: Nesmith still questionable, Haliburton out. Morning panel kept 2-1.
legs.injury_notes: IND: Haliburton, Furphy, Sheppard out; Nesmith questionable.

legs.reasoning: Toppin has cleared 14.5 PRA in 9 of last 10 (last 5: 4/5) while Indiana is missing Haliburton, Sheppard and Furphy and Nesmith is questionable; if Nesmith sits, Toppin's minutes go up further. Book -130 (~55% fair). Risk: bench role and Knicks -8.5 game script. Same game as Towns and Nembhard; don't stack all three.
legs.injury_notes: IND: Haliburton, Furphy, Sheppard out; Nesmith questionable.

legs.reasoning: Wembanyama averages 11.7 rebounds and SportsLine projects 12.1. Golden State is missing Curry, Butler, Moody, Brandon Williams and Porzingis, which removes their size and means more misses. Tobias Harris (calf) is out for SA, taking a rebounder off the floor. Book -128 (~54% fair). Honest counterpoint: he has gone over 11.5 only twice in his last six (two misses at 11), and a SA blowout could trim minutes.
legs.injury_notes: GS: Curry, Butler, Moody, B. Williams, Porzingis out. SA: Harris out; Fox, Vassell questionable.
